newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger down after 9-mo earnings drop.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger down after 9-mo earnings drop.

text.p: Shares in building materials firm Wienerberger initially dipped 1.2 percent in Vienna on Thursday after the firm reported a 20 percent drop in pre-tax profit but the stock quickly recovered part of its losses.
At 0837 GMT Wienerberger shares were trading 11.1 schillings down at 1,990 off a low of 1,975.2.
"The results were more or less in line with expectations after the poor first half," said a trader at a leading Austrian bank.
"The main disappointment was the (almost) 40 percent drop in wall, ceiling and roofing systems," he added.
Wienerberger's group pre-tax profit fell to 1.041 billion schillings from 1.303 billion. Earnings before interest and tax fell to 1.32 billion from 1.4 billion.
Pre-tax profit in wall, ceiling and roofing tumbled 36.7 percent to 540 million schillings.

Wienerberger earlier on Thursday reported a 20 percent drop in nine-month pretax profit and a 5.7 percent decline in earnings before interest and taxes, citing a severe winter and a general declinei in the construction industry.
